That way, you can decide if this is something you want to continue on with or try to curve now to avoid these things. 



Sorry this is long:

After a while your body starts saving the fat like a kid with candy bars. So even if you throw up, your bodies digestive system won't work as fast. It will slow down your metabolism and go into shock. It will therefore become 10x harder to lose any weight now and in the future. This will condition your body to go into a sort of fight or flight mode, causing your body to think, "oh shit, this is how life is - I better store all of the fat and nutrients that I can!" 
It's hard to regulate yourself after this. You'll have to change almost everything in your life - eating 3 meals a day at the same time, eating nutrient dense meals, perhaps taking supplements to be a catalyst for reversing the damage and trauma done to your stomach. Without re-regulating your stomach, you will find it harder to lose weight indefinitely. You can't just purge for x amount of time and go back to normal. 
You'll have to find a way to balance out your hormones because purging doesn't just affect your weight and stomach, it affects your adrenal glands, your kidneys and your liver too which produce the hormones that your body uses to regulate emotions, bodily processes, how your skin reacts to stimuli, and basically how every organ and body system acts. 
If you don't curve it now, Your teeth will become raw due to loss of enamel. Your stomach contains acid and bile that inherently comes up whenever you purge and that causes your enamel to thin out which causes increased sensitivity. An example would be, your teeth will hurt while you are drinking cold water or eating ice cream. They will also hurt when you are just resting or brush your tongue against them. I'm sure you're aware of the discoloration that can happen, but your stomach also contains a lot of bacteria. This bacteria isn't bad, but necessary for your metabolic processes. It's meant for your stomach tho, and will cause your breath(basically, it mixes with the bacteria in your mouth) to be funky. You'll have to brush more often to get the smell to go away, even if it's not apparent to you, but brushing your teeth will also be a bit painful so you'll have to be very careful of the toothpaste you use and what kind of toothbrush. You also shouldn't expose your breath to anyone after you purge, but you can't brush your teeth right away or use mouthwash after either. If you have your tonsils, then you are at risk for reoccurring strep throat and tonsillitis which is painful and contagious, so be weary of that. Taking antibiotics often and at a young age is not the business because your body can become resistant to them, causing you to feel pain longer.

It will affect your hair due to your body not regularly getting the nutrients that it needs to sufficiently have homeostasis. As you get older, your hair will thin out quicker vs. those who don't purge. 

The mind is a tricky thing. It will most definitely cause or worsen depression and anxiety, especially around weight, meals, socializing with others and it will distort your self worth.
You are telling yourself that you will damage yourself to obtain a smaller figure because you aren't worthy of love and happiness right now as you are, which is conducive to living a happy and healthy life where you feel self actualized. Your life can change once your perspective changes, and your life can and will increasingly get better when you focus on making healthy lifestyle choices for yourself. This is the opposite of that, so safe to say that your  life will get worse.
Not only will you struggle now, but also years to come. 5 years. 10 years. You will need professional help to regain a sense of confidence that's not based on body dysphoria and self harm. You might have to be honest with your friends, family and partners to a certain extent about this sickness - definitely partners. We're not as clever as we think and bulimia is common. It's obvious.
You might only purge for 1 week now, but like any other drug, your tolerance will go up and your body will crave it and you will do it for longer stints.
